text:
elaine: Quick preflight for KelpNet private/VPC dry-run tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need checks: VPC peering parity, NAT count/capacity, CMK grants for redwood-audit & CloudTrail, and S3 audit-bucket lifecycle. Tagging @ben @priya :wave:

ben: On it. Prioritize prod, analytics, cache-private. I'll scan peering attachments and route tables.

priya: I'll validate the CMK policy and rotation status. If CloudTrail principal missing, we'll add: `{\"Principal\":{\"Service\":\"cloudtrail.amazonaws.com\"},\"Action\":[\"kms:Encrypt\",\"kms:GenerateDataKey\"]}`. Also capture key creation date for compliance.

ben: Found analytics-rtb missing peer route to prod-cidr. Patch planned: `aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-0k1l2m3 --destination-cidr-block 10.90.0.0/16 --vpc-peering-connection-id pcx-0k9l8m7` (will record change id).

ops-bot: infra-bot: Route create event recorded (chg-0k9l8m7) by ben at 2026-03-28T20:11:02Z

ben: NATs: account has 1 NAT in us-west-2 (nat-0k11). Analytics subnets were pointing at IGW; switched to NAT and queued smoke tests. Also flagged sg-0k77 with wide egress 0.0.0.0/0 ephemeral ports on app-tier  will tighten.

elaine: Please upload SG/NAT/route snapshots to a gist for the ticket once done. Also note procurement requested HSM-backed keys; mark renewal risk accordingly and ask Solutions for cost delta.

priya: KMS arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/k1l2m3 created 2024-09-10. Policy missing CloudTrail principal; rotation ON. I'll open a PR for the policy and add a short migration step to enable SSE-KMS on the audit bucket and a one-off s3 cp to re-encrypt objects.

ben: uploaded gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/kelpnet-net-snapshot (routes, SG export, NAT list).

elaine: thanks team. I'll update the onboarding runbook, add renewal risk "medium - HSM requested", and send to KelpNet ops for acknowledgement. Dry-run 09:00 PT tomorrow. Closing this preflight. :thumbsup:
